pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhaṃ sikkhamānaṃ saṅghena asammataṃ vuṭṭhāpenti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.4: etha sikkhamānā imaṃ jānātha imaṃ detha imaṃ āharatha iminā attho imaṃ kappiyaṃ karothāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.6: na mayaṃ ayye sikkhamānā bhikkhuniyo mayanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.7: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhaṃ sikkhamānaṃ saṅghena asammataṃ vuṭṭhāpessantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.9: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhaṃ sikkhamānaṃ saṅghena asammataṃ vuṭṭhāpentīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.12: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhaṃ sikkhamānaṃ saṅghena asammataṃ vuṭṭhāpessanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.16: anujānāmi bhikkhave dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya sikkhamānāya vuṭṭhānasammatiṃ dātuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.18: tāya dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya sikkhamānāya saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā bhikkhunīnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.19: ahaṃ ayye itthannāmā itthannāmāya ayyāya dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhā sikkhamānā saṅghaṃ vuṭṭhānasammatiṃ yācāmīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.24: ayaṃ itthannāmā itthannāmāya ayyāya dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhā sikkhamānā saṅghaṃ vuṭṭhānasammatiṃ yācati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.25: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho itthannāmāya dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya sikkhamānāya vuṭṭhānasammatiṃ dadeyya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.28: ayaṃ itthannāmā itthannāmāya ayyāya dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhā sikkhamānā saṅghaṃ vuṭṭhānasammatiṃ yācati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.29: saṅgho itthannāmāya dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya sikkhamānāya vuṭṭhānasammatiṃ deti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.30: yassā ayyāya khamati itthannāmāya dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya sikkhamānāya vuṭṭhānasammatiyā dānaṃ sā tuṇhassa
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.32: dinnā saṅghena itthannāmāya dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya sikkhamānāya vuṭṭhānasammati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.33: khamati saṅghassa tasmā tuṇhī. evametaṃ dhārayāmīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.34: athakho bhagavā tā bhikkhuniyo anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā dubbharatāya …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.35: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.36.1: yā pana bhikkhunī dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhaṃ sikkhamānaṃ saṅghena asammataṃ vuṭṭhāpeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:2.10: ñattidutiyena kammena vuṭṭhānasammati na dinnā hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:2.13: vuṭṭhāpessāmīti gaṇaṃ vā ācariniṃ vā pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā pariyesati sīmaṃ vā sammannati āpatti dukkaṭassa
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:2.17: gaṇassa ca ācariniyā ca āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:2.25: dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhaṃ sikkhamānaṃ saṅghena sammataṃ vuṭṭhāpeti
